name: 飛ぶかたち, 1984 (g/8); 鳴るかたち, 1984 (h); 梳くかたち, 1984 (i)
note: Three stone and wood sculptures, each pairing a rough stone with carved wood forms. Sizes printed for h are 60×65×186 cm and for i are 170×107×50 cm; g/8 has no dimensions. The page lists them as shown at the 2nd Toyama International Contemporary Art Exhibition, Toyama Prefectural Museum of Modern Art, 1984.
